method: Shows rumors from the last 5 US Eastern days; older rumors are removed. Rumor = headline with rumor wording (reports, sources, could, interest, target, trade talks...) plus a roster topic. Status flips to Confirmed/Denied when a later headline names the same person with confirm/deny wording. Automated keyword matching, so it can be wrong; every item links to the source.
